lines.text: Everyone talks about stocks. But what are you actually buying?
lines.say: Everyone talks about stocks. But what are you actually buying?

lines.text: A stock is a tiny piece of ownership in a company. Each piece is called a share.
lines.say: A stock is a tiny piece of ownership in a company. Each piece is called a share.

lines.text: If a company has a million shares and you own a hundred, you own one hundredth of one percent.
lines.say: If a company has a million shares and you own a hundred, you own one hundredth of one percent.

lines.text: You can make money two ways: the price goes up, or the company pays a dividend.
lines.say: You can make money two ways: the price goes up, or the company pays a dividend.

lines.text: But prices can fall, even to zero. That's why many people spread their money across many companies.
lines.say: But prices can fall, even to zero. That's why many people spread their money across many companies.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.
